body.x: SKonec Entertainment introduced ‘VR shopping mall system’ by participating at ‘2017 Korea Electronics Show(KES)’ which is hosted at Samsung-dong Coex for 4 days from 17th of October(Tues) to 20th(Fri).

SKonec Entertainment is a global leading company in VR industry which introduced world's first VR gun shooting game to the market. It deals with AR project contents development & service and converged VR contents development & service across many fields of industry, such as consumer-oriented VR game development, manufacturing, education, medical etc.

In this exhibition, it mainly introduced VR shopping mall to clients. VR shopping mall was launched this September and people can actually purchase products in this system which helps with clients’ convenience. It is available on both PC and Mobile platforms.
Senior researcher of SKonec Entertainment, Bum-do Kim said, “we will launch VR square in Hongdae, VR square is a VR Multiplex with VR as its main content.”

Meanwhile, KES 2017, hosted by Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy and sponsored by KEA (Korea Electronics Association), is an international show where lots of potential buyers, governments, group officials participate, providing a good place to experience world first products like mobile phone, semiconductor, display, and next generation convergence solutions like industrial convergence, IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education and e health.
